descriptions.w3d_card_guide_probe: Memory-card guide: probes the card for memory and sector size, logs the result and maps it to a guide message.
descriptions.w3d_card_guide_mount: Memory-card guide: mounts the card with the guide's work area, logs the result and maps it to a guide message.
descriptions.w3d_card_guide_check: Memory-card guide: checks the mounted card's file system, logs the result and maps it to a guide message.
descriptions.w3d_card_guide_format: Memory-card guide: formats the card, logs the result and maps it to a guide message.
descriptions.w3d_card_guide_unformat: Memory-card guide: unformats the card, logs the result and maps it to a guide message.
descriptions.w3d_card_guide_get: Returns the global registry list at 0x80368bd8 used by the reference-counted objects created at 0x802c5c68.
